import subprocess, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/output/csfix'); p.mkdir(parents=True)
(p/'marker.txt').write_text('SYNTHMARKER')
(p/'bad.dtd').write_text('NOT A DTD <')
(p/'mini.dtd').write_text('<!ELEMENT module (module|property)*>\n<!ATTLIST module name CDATA #IMPLIED>\n<!ELEMENT property EMPTY>\n<!ATTLIST property name CDATA #IMPLIED value CDATA #IMPLIED>\n')
(p/'Stub.java').write_text('public class Stub {}\n')
def xml(n,b):
    (p/n).write_text(b)
xml('ge.xml','<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module [\n<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">\n]>\n<module name="Checker">&xxe;</module>\n')
xml('sysbad.xml','<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/bad.dtd">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n')
xml('sysgood.xml','<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/mini.dtd">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ['ge.xml','sysbad.xml','sysgood.xml']:
    r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(p/cfg),str(p/'Stub.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
    blob=r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr
    print('CASE',cfg,'rc',r.returncode,'marker',('SYNTHMARKER' in blob))
    print(blob.replace('SYNTHMARKER','<MARKER>')[:700])
    print('---')
